ns2:section.sectionText: Spring ME 470 registration is for students whose UIN ends in an odd number (for students who started at UIUC before FA22). Spring ME 470 registration is for students whose UIN ends in an even number (for students who started at UIUC in or after FA22). To petition a change in this spring registration, please go to https://my.mechse.illinois.edu/ugpetitions/ You will receive a TIME CONFLICT AND AN APPROVAL ERROR when registering for this course. To receive the necessary overrides to register, please email Robbie Vermillion (rvermil2@illinois.edu) or Tammy Smith (tssmith1@illinois.edu).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Mechanical Sci & Engineering department.
